To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the EHS and the SHIM are the most frequently used PROs in ED clinical trials, and (2) the EHS is a valid and reliable instrument to measure erectile quality and is a useful tool for clinical practice and research.

the SHIM and the IIEF-EF are both valid and reliable measures of erectile function, the IIEF-QoE is a valid and reliable measure of erectile quality, the SHIM is a valid and clinically relevant instrument for diagnosis of ED, the EHS is a valid measure of erection hardness and is useful in assessing efficacy of treatment, the IIEFTS is a valid and useful measure of treatment satisfaction, the SEAR is a valid and sensitive measure of sexual and emotional health
the SHIM is a reliable and valid measure of the severity of ED.
